name: Alaska

creditorClaims.text: Pre-death claims are barred unless presented within 4 months after the first publication of notice to creditors, or within 3 years after death if notice was not published (AS 13.16.460(a)).

earliestClose.text: Outside supervised administration, an estate may be closed by verified statement no earlier than 6 months after original appointment, stating that notice to creditors was first published more than 6 months earlier (AS 13.16.630).

smallEstate.text: Thirty days after death, successors may collect property by affidavit if the entire estate, less liens and encumbrances, consists only of personal property not exceeding $50,000 plus registered vehicles with a total value not exceeding $100,000, and no personal representative application is pending (AS 13.16.680). Not indexed.

simplified.text: Summary administration: if the estate does not exceed family allowances, exempt property, administration costs, funeral and last-illness expenses, the personal representative may distribute and close at any time by verified statement (AS 13.16.690, 13.16.695).

filingFee.text: Superior court filing fee of $250.00 upon filing a trust or estate action other than registration or deposit of a will (Alaska Administrative Rule 9(b)(2)(A)).

personalRepFee.text: A personal representative is entitled to reasonable compensation for services (AS 13.16.430), reviewable by the court (AS 13.16.440).

attorneyFee.text: No statutory schedule: the court may review the reasonableness of compensation of any attorney employed by the personal representative (AS 13.16.440); reasonable attorney fees in good-faith estate litigation are paid from the estate (AS 13.16.435).
